## Controller

PionierGarage e.V., Straße am Forum 1, 76131 Karlsruhe, Germany. Send privacy enquiries to [datenschutz@pioniergarage.de](mailto:datenschutz@pioniergarage.de).

## Visiting the site

When you open a page, the server infrastructure processes connection data such as your IP address and the requested page to deliver the site and keep it secure. Our legitimate interest is the availability and security of the site (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)).

## Contact, partnership and membership

When you contact us, we use your information to handle and reply to your enquiry. Our legitimate interest is communicating with people who contact the association (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)). When you request steps before entering into an agreement, GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) applies. Depending on the form, we use your name, contact details and message or application. We mark required fields in the form. We need that information to process your request.

When you use a linked Tally form, Tally receives connection data and sends us the form responses to process. [Tally data processing information](https://tally.so/help/gdpr).

If you opt in to the newsletter, we use your email address to send it (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)). You may withdraw consent through the unsubscribe link or by emailing us.

## Retention

Retention depends on the purpose. Contact details and messages are needed while handling the request and any necessary follow-up. Statutory retention duties or the establishment and defence of legal claims may require longer storage. We need the newsletter address for delivery while the subscription is active.

## Your rights

Under GDPR Arts. 15 to 22, you may request access, correction, erasure, restriction or portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You may withdraw consent at any time for future processing. You may also lodge a complaint with a [data protection authority](https://www.baden-wuerttemberg.datenschutz.de/beschwerde/).
